name: country_of_city
description: Name the country a famous city is in (Paris -> France). Control copies the city name.
generator_code:
import random, json
random.seed(0)
P=[('Paris','France'),('Lyon','France'),('Berlin','Germany'),('Munich','Germany'),('Tokyo','Japan'),('Osaka','Japan'),('Beijing','China'),('Shanghai','China'),('Rome','Italy'),('Milan','Italy'),('Madrid','Spain'),('Barcelona','Spain'),('Moscow','Russia'),('Toronto','Canada'),('Vancouver','Canada'),('Mumbai','India'),('Delhi','India'),('Sydney','Australia'),('Melbourne','Australia'),('Cairo','Egypt'),('Lisbon','Portugal'),('Athens','Greece'),('Dublin','Ireland'),('Vienna','Austria'),('Warsaw','Poland'),('Stockholm','Sweden'),('Oslo','Norway'),('Seoul','Korea'),('Bangkok','Thailand'),('Istanbul','Turkey'),('Amsterdam','Netherlands'),('Brussels','Belgium')]
items=[];control=[]
for i in range(96):
    c,k=P[i%len(P)]
    fr=random.choice(['Geography.','Travel note.','Quick fact.'])
    items.append({"prompt":f"{fr} The city of {c} is located in the country of","answer":" "+k})
    control.append({"prompt":f"{fr} The city of {c} is located in a country. The city named here is","answer":" "+c})
json.dump({"items":items,"control":control},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
